name: Analytics Dashboard
description: A calm store dashboard: KPI cards that drive a morphing SVG area chart with crosshair, 7/30/90-day ranges, channel bars and an orders table that turns into cards.

props.name: days
props.description: Daily { date, revenue, orders, sessions }, oldest first. Supply twice the longest range so every KPI has a previous period to compare with.

props.name: defaultMetric
props.description: KPI the main chart shows first. Clicking a KPI card switches it.

props.name: channels
props.description: Revenue share per channel for each range (0–1). Amounts are derived from the period's revenue.

props.name: orders
props.description: Recent orders: id, customer, items, channel, status (Paid | Fulfilled | Pending | Refunded), total, placed.

props.name: nav
props.type: { label: string; icon: DashboardNavIcon; href: string; badge?: string; active?: boolean }[]
props.description: Sidebar links. Icons are keys: overview, orders, products, customers, analytics, marketing, settings.

props.name: payout
props.type: { label: string; amount: string; note: string }
props.description: The payout card pinned to the bottom of the sidebar.

props.name: storeName
props.description: Workspace name in the sidebar and mobile top bar.

props.name: storeUrl
props.description: Secondary line under the store name.

props.name: user
props.description: Signed-in person at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Date and freshness line under the heading.

name: Receipt Pricing
description: Lifetime pricing printed as a thermal receipt on deep green: torn edges, line items, a stamped total, a barcode and ticket tabs that re-print it.

props.name: options
props.description: One receipt per licence: id, tab label and caption, total, licence and order codes, line items, summary rows and a CTA.

props.name: title
props.description: First line of the headline, in the display face.

props.name: titleAccent
props.description: Second line, italic serif in pale mint.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark printed at the top of the receipt.

props.name: stamp
props.description: Red rubber stamp across the total.

props.name: thanks
props.description: Sign-off at the foot of the receipt.

name: Particle Sphere
description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 shader-lit particles breathing with simplex noise, wrapped in a tilted orbit. Pointer parallax, responsive, offscreen-aware.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: colors
props.description: Rim highlight, mid-tone and core colours.
